comment: The queue of md/qm/gr/queue_prod.json as it runs on the rented machine (tasks gr_points, gr_relax_* of md/gpu/tasks_gr.json). Same points, same settings of the quantum chemistry (md/qm/config_prod.json), same folders. Different: threads 7 (the Pi: 4); nothing is waited for (wait_for of the Pi's file names the job of the Pi that ended at 7:07 AM IST; on the machine that path belongs to task qm_opt, which runs beside); no reference energy of the timing job (the Pi made that comparison for X). The order is that of md/qm/gr/points.json (d2 and Nx before the turns about N2-S since 9 AM IST; until 9:40 AM this file carried the same order as `order_first`). `relax`: settings of the relaxed references of part B.
